eastTexasReviews.author: Kathy P.
eastTexasReviews.highlight: Not as much as a nail was found on the ground when they were gone
eastTexasReviews.quote: Raymond Hardin and his crew roofed my house and did a great job. They took off the old shingles, replaced boards and trim, and put on new shingles, plus a new top on my patio. After all of this, they built me a new garage. They are all very kind, and they cleaned up everything. Not as much as a nail was found on the ground when they were gone. This is a good group of guys you can depend on to do a great job.

eastTexasReviews.author: Grigor W.
eastTexasReviews.highlight: Everyone from the front office to the workers was friendly and efficient
eastTexasReviews.quote: Great people, great company. Everyone from the front office, to the rep, to the workers was friendly, helpful, and efficient. The work was done quickly and efficiently. And the workers themselves were great—very nice guys. And they cleaned up everything perfectly.
